# C S Rushil & Co.
> Chartered accountancy firm in Anna Nagar, Chennai, founded in 2024 by CA Rushil C S
> (Certified FAFD, Start-up Mentor) with a 16-member team — company incorporation, GST,
> audit, direct tax, ROC compliance, and virtual CFO services. Consultations in English,
> Tamil, and Hindi. Remote service available for NRI and overseas clients.

## Services
- [Private Limited Company Incorporation Chennai](https://csrushil.com/private-limited-company-incorporation-chennai): SPICe+ incorporation process, entity comparison, timelines
- [Formation of Business Entity](https://csrushil.com/formation-of-business-entity): Choosing and registering the right structure (Pvt Ltd, LLP, OPC, Partnership, Proprietorship)
- [LLP Registration Chennai](https://csrushil.com/llp-registration-chennai): FiLLiP filing, LLP Agreement drafting, conversion from partnership
- [Company Registration Chennai](https://csrushil.com/company-registration-chennai): Private Limited, LLP, and OPC registration
- [GST Litigation Chennai](https://csrushil.com/gst-litigation-chennai): Show-cause notice replies, appeals, GST Appellate Tribunal representation
- [Goods & Services Tax](https://csrushil.com/goods-and-services-tax): GST registration, return filing, amendments, cancellations
- [GST Registration Chennai](https://csrushil.com/gst-registration-chennai): New GST registration, amendments, LUT applications
- [Audit & Assurance](https://csrushil.com/audit-and-assurance): Statutory, internal, tax, transfer pricing, forensic, and stock audits
- [Statutory Audit Chennai](https://csrushil.com/statutory-audit-chennai): Companies Act audit under Section 139
- [Tax Audit Chennai](https://csrushil.com/tax-audit-chennai): Section 44AB tax audit, Form 3CA/3CB/3CD
- [Transfer Pricing Audit](https://csrushil.com/transfer-pricing-audit): Form 3CEB, arm's-length pricing documentation
- [Direct Tax](https://csrushil.com/direct-tax): Income tax planning, return filing, assessment representation
- [Income Tax Return Filing Chennai](https://csrushil.com/income-tax-return-filing-chennai): ITR filing for individuals, professionals, NRIs, and businesses
- [MSME / Udyam Registration Chennai](https://csrushil.com/msme-udyam-registration-chennai): Udyam registration process and MSMED Act benefits
- [ROC Compliances](https://csrushil.com/roc-compliances): Annual filings, statutory registers, DIR-3 KYC
- [Virtual CFO Services](https://csrushil.com/virtual-cfo-services): MIS reporting, budgeting, fundraising support
- [Management Consultancy](https://csrushil.com/management-consultancy): Business process, risk, and growth advisory
- [RERA Compliance](https://csrushil.com/rera): Project registration, QPR filings for Tamil Nadu developers
- [Trust & NGO Registration](https://csrushil.com/trust): Trust deed, Society, Section 8 Company, 12A/80G registration
- [CA Fees & Pricing](https://csrushil.com/ca-fees-chennai): Indicative pricing for incorporation, GST, and audit services
